title: Verify Parts Technician can create a Part Sales invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (this role's Invoicing: Create and Edit is scoped to the Part Sales invoice path per SV-7903 - works as designed; work order invoices are the Service Advisor's job).
A customer and a RECEIVED part with a part number exist (parts must be received with a part number before invoicing).
steps:
1. Click Part Sales in the main navigation.
2. Click to create a new Part Sales invoice.
3. Add the part and customer and save the invoice.
expected: The Part Sales invoice is created successfully.
